question: The country's first earthquake early warning mobile application 'Bhookamp' has been developed in which of the following IITs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Roorkee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The country's first **Earthquake Early Warning (EEW)** mobile application, named **'Uttarakhand Bhookamp Alert'**, was developed by the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Roorkee**.
 
• The project was carried out in collaboration with the **Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority (USDMA)** to provide timely alerts to the public.
 
• This application is the **first-of-its-kind** in India and is designed to detect the onset of an earthquake and issue warnings before the destructive waves reach a particular location.
 
• One of the standout features of the app is its ability to send the **geographic location** of people who might be trapped during a disaster, facilitating faster search and rescue operations.
